suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document protocol for handling already-completed features: workers should verify the previous work (tests, linting) and report success without re-implementing.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature hooks-deduplication was already completed by a prior worker. The current worker correctly verified the commit and exited.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance to hooks-worker skill for script consolidation: when consolidating auto-executing scripts, wrap their execution in 'if (require.main === module)' and add exports so they can be safely imported.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: In hooks-consolidation feature, the worker successfully used this pattern to make existing scripts importable into a bundle.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Reinforce that workers must strictly follow TDD (Write tests first) as documented in their skills, and not edit implementation code before writing tests.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: In hooks-if-conditions, the transcript shows the worker edited implementation files before creating tests, violating the skill procedure.
